Overview

What legal assistance covers — and who it’s for.

DefinitionLegal assistance — also known as legal process outsourcing (LPO) — is delegating legal support work such as research, document review, drafting support and administration to an external team, supervised by licensed attorneys.

Legal teams are expected to move at the speed of the business while carrying an ever-growing volume of contracts, research requests and compliance obligations. The work that consumes the most hours — first drafts, document review, tracking deadlines — is rarely the work that most needs a senior lawyer.

Akrostech provides paralegal-level professionals who work within your matter-management systems, templates and playbooks. They produce research memos, first drafts and review summaries for your attorneys to check and finalise, and they keep compliance calendars and documentation in order. Confidentiality is designed into every engagement from day one.

It’s built for General Counsel running lean in-house teams, law-firm partners who need flexible capacity, and compliance leaders tracking obligations across multiple jurisdictions.

Akrostech provides legal support services under the supervision of your licensed attorneys. We do not provide legal advice or representation.

FAQ

Legal Assistance, answered.

The questions decision-makers ask us before they sign. Something missing? Ask us directly.

Do you provide legal advice?

No. Akrostech provides legal support services only. All work is performed under the supervision of your licensed attorneys, who remain responsible for legal advice and representation.

How do you protect privileged and confidential information?

Every engagement starts with NDAs and a conflicts check. Work happens in your systems or a restricted workspace, with role-based access and full audit trails.

Is your team legally trained?

Yes. Our legal assistants hold law degrees or paralegal qualifications and are trained on the jurisdictions and practice areas they support.

Which jurisdictions can you support?

We support work relating to the USA, UK, EU, Australia and the UAE, always under the direction of attorneys qualified in the relevant jurisdiction.

Who supervises the work?

Your attorneys do. We agree supervision, review and escalation rules up front, and nothing leaves our team as final without attorney approval.
